label: Opening Hook
text: Deep underground in Poland, miners carved an entire chapel from rock salt, down to the chandeliers.
title: File:Wieliczka, St Kingas Chapel (6467348331).jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Salt was mined at Wieliczka from the 13th century until 1996 Reaches about 327 m deep, with more than 280 km of passages St Kinga's Chapel was carved over several decades from 1896, about 100 m below ground Its chandeliers are made of salt crystals One of the first UNESCO World Heritage Sites (1978)
title: File:Wieliczka - kaplica sw. Kingi - The chapel of st. Kunigund przed 1939 (87073520).jpg
